item.immersive_trains.bomb_bay.descripti: Drops TNT, does not ruin blocks but deals heavy hurt.
item.immersive_trains.telescope.descript: A heftier form of the spyglass.
item.immersive_trains.heavy_crossbow.des: A heavy crossbow with a strong punch, needs arrows.
item.immersive_trains.airship.descriptio: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.immersive_trains.cargo_airship.desc: Slow and fuel greedy but carries a whole storage.
item.immersive_trains.warship.descriptio: A flying fortress, slow but well-armed.
item.immersive_trains.biplane.descriptio: Fast and rather trusty. Make sure your runway is long enough.
item.immersive_trains.gyrodyne.descripti: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.immersive_trains.quadrocopter.descr: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.immersive_trains.bamboo_hopper.desc: A hefty aircraft with three seats and floaters to land safely on water.
immersive_trains.gyrodyne_target_reached: Minimum rotor speed reached, ready for takeoff!
immersive_trains.invalid_dimension: This aircraft does not work in this realm.
immersive_trains.fat.out: You are too hungry to fly!
option.immersive_trains.separateCamera: Use a separate camera in aircraft.
option.immersive_trains.useThirdPersonBy: Defaults to third person camera in aircraft.
option.immersive_trains.useCustomKeybind: Use multi-keybindings, may break certain mods.
option.immersive_trains.showHotbarEngine: Show the engine gauge over the hotbar.
option.immersive_trains.crashDamage: Harm the player on a crash.
option.immersive_trains.preventKillThrou: Will not slay the player on a crash.
option.immersive_trains.healthBarRow: Offset the health bar of vehicles.
option.immersive_trains.damagePerHealthP: Higher values make craft more durable.
option.immersive_trains.weaponsAreDestru: Allow some weapons to break blocks.
option.immersive_trains.dropInventory: Drop the stock, instead of saving it within the flying device item.
option.immersive_trains.dropUpgrades: Drop the upgrades and tweaking, instead of saving it within the flying device item.
option.immersive_trains.regenerateHealth: Automatically restores health every given tick, simulating regular behavior.
option.immersive_trains.requireShiftForR: Only repair while holding shift, else just enter the vehicle.
immersive_trains.tooltip.no_target: Needs to be built on the ground!
